>snippet 1: we prepare the dataset by loading and pruning the phylogeny, loading and matching the suture morphology data and the biological traits data, standardising and regressing suture complexity metrics by centroid size to account for allometric biases; from this point onwards, only scaled residuals will be used. Continuous biological predictors are also mathematically standardised, but not regressed with size variables.

```{r, 1) dataset preparation for PMM}

# ============================================================
# Dataset preparation pipeline for PMM
# ============================================================

library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(MCMCglmm)

# -------------------------------
# Load phylogeny
# -------------------------------
tree <- read.tree("D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/4705sp_mean.nwk") # filepath for the tree
tree$tip.label <- gsub(" ", "_", tree$tip.label)

# -------------------------------
# Load suture-level measurements
# -------------------------------
data <- read.csv("D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/thrice_rescaled/complete_recast_metrics.csv", # file path for the complexity data set
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data$species <- gsub(" ", "_", data$species)

# -------------------------------
# Load species-level traits
# -------------------------------
species_traits <- read.csv("D:/Suppl_Mat/for_coauthors/Species_traits_sutures.csv", # file path for the biological trait data set
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
species_traits$species <- gsub(" ", "_", species_traits$species)

# -------------------------------
# Normalize species names
# -------------------------------
data$species <- tolower(data$species)
tree$tip.label <- tolower(tree$tip.label)
species_traits$species <- tolower(species_traits$species)

# -------------------------------
# Filter to species in tree
# -------------------------------
data <- data[data$species %in% tree$tip.label, ]

# Prune tree
pruned_tree <- keep.tip(tree, unique(data$species))

# Merge traits into suture-level dataset
data <- merge(data, species_traits, by = "species", all.x = TRUE)

# Create unique ID for each suture observation
data$suture_id <- paste(data$species, data$suture, sep = "_")



# -------------------------------
# Make tree ultrametric + inverse A matrix
# -------------------------------
library("dispRity")
# compute ages

recent<-pruned_tree$tip.label
ages <- tree.age(pruned_tree, digits = 10)

# make all recent tips extant
for(i in 1:length(recent)) {
  
  # get the tip
  this_tip <- recent[i]
  
  # if this tip is in the tree...
  if (this_tip %in% ages$elements) {
  
    # get the age
    this_age <- ages$age[ages$elements == this_tip]
    
    # get the new age
    new_age <- 0
    
    # get the old branch length
    tip_index <- which(pruned_tree$tip.label == this_tip)
    old_bl    <- pruned_tree$edge.length[pruned_tree$edge[,2] == tip_index]
    
    # compute the delta      
    delta <- new_age - this_age
    
    # compute the new branch length
    new_bl <- old_bl - delta
    
    # update the branch length
   pruned_tree$edge.length[pruned_tree$edge[,2] == tip_index] <- new_bl
    
  }
  
}


invA <- inverseA(pruned_tree, nodes = "TIPS", scale = TRUE)$Ainv
pruned_tree -> nu_tree

# Alignment sanity check
if (!all(unique(data$species) %in% rownames(invA))) {
  warning("Some species in data are not in the phylogenetic inverse matrix")
}


# -------------------------------
# Define variables
# -------------------------------
responses <- c("best_alpha","Convexity","Rugosity",
               "Sphericity","FD","centroid_size_mm")

predictors <- c("primary_diet","locomotion","habitat", 
                "suture","typical_lifespan","gestation_length", 
               "ln_body_mass_g","ln_brain_mass_g","weaning_age")

# -------------------------------
# Factor handling
# -------------------------------
factor_vars <- c("primary_diet","locomotion","habitat","suture")
factor_vars <- factor_vars[factor_vars %in% colnames(data)]
data[factor_vars] <- lapply(data[factor_vars], factor)

# -------------------------------
# Check predictors and responses exist
# -------------------------------
existing_predictors <- predictors[predictors %in% colnames(data)]
responses <- responses[responses %in% colnames(data)]

# Keep only complete rows for predictors
data <- data[complete.cases(data[, existing_predictors]), ]


# -------------------------------
# Create inverted complexity variables (1 / x), keep originals
# -------------------------------

invert_map <- c(
  best_alpha   = "alpha_complexity",
  Convexity    = "Concavity",
  Sphericity   = "Antisphericity"
)

invert_map <- invert_map[names(invert_map) %in% colnames(data)]

for (v in names(invert_map)) {
  new_var <- invert_map[[v]]
  
  # Safety check
  if (any(data[[v]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop(paste("Zero values detected in", v, "- cannot invert safely."))
  }
  
  data[[new_var]] <- 1 / data[[v]]
}


# -------------------------------
# Scale continuous variables
# -------------------------------

cont_vars <- c(
  "best_alpha", "Convexity", "Rugosity",
  "Sphericity",  "FD", "centroid_size_mm",
  "typical_lifespan", "weaning_age",
  "gestation_length", "ln_body_mass_g", "ln_brain_mass_g",
  # NEW inverted variables
  "alpha_complexity", "Concavity", "Antisphericity"
)

cont_vars <- cont_vars[cont_vars %in% colnames(data)]
data[cont_vars] <- scale(data[cont_vars])


# ============================================================
# Allometry significance + residual extraction
# ============================================================

allometry_vars <- c("alpha_complexity", "Concavity", "Antisphericity", "best_alpha", "Convexity", "Rugosity","Sphericity", "FD")

allometry_vars <- allometry_vars[allometry_vars %in% colnames(data)]

results_list <- list()

for (v in allometry_vars) {

  # Fit linear model for allometry
  model <- lm(data[[v]] ~ data$centroid_size_mm)

  # Add residuals to dataset
  data[[paste0(v, "_res")]] <- resid(model)

  # Extract statistics
  slope <- coef(summary(model))[2, 1]          # β1
  p_value <- coef(summary(model))[2, 4]        # p-value for β1
  r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared               # R²
  
  # Save results
  results_list[[v]] <- data.frame(
    variable = v,
    slope = slope,
    p_value = p_value,
    r_squared = r2
  )
}

# Combine into a single results table
allometry_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# Show results
allometry_results



```

>snippet 2: we set up and run a first round of multi-response phylogenetic mixed models (MR-PMM) to assess the relationships between morphological variables; this is an intercept-only model without predictors, which allows us to assess the phylogenetic vs residual correlations among morphological variables. It also allows us to estimate phylogenetic signal of each morphological response variable.

```{r, 2) intercept-only MR(multi-response)-PMM + phylogenetic signal}
# ============================================================
# Intercept-only MR-PMM for phylogenetic vs residual correlations
# ============================================================

library(MCMCglmm)


#reframe scaled residuals as responses
responses <- c("alpha_complexity_res","Concavity_res","Rugosity_res",
               "Antisphericity_res","FD_res")

fit_intercept_only_model <- function(responses, data, nu_tree) {
  df <- data
  df <- df[complete.cases(df[, responses]), ]   # keep complete rows for all responses
  df$animal <- df$species
  
  # Prior for multi-response: residual + phylo covariance
  prior_multi <- list(
    R = list(V = diag(length(responses)), nu = length(responses) + 0.002),
    G = list(G1 = list(V = diag(length(responses)), nu = length(responses) + 0.002))
  )
  
  # Intercept-only fixed formula (~ 1)
  fixed_formula <- as.formula(
    paste("cbind(", paste(responses, collapse = ", "), ") ~ 1")
  )
  
  model <- MCMCglmm(
    fixed = fixed_formula,
    random = ~ us(trait):animal,   # phylogenetic covariance among traits
    rcov   = ~ us(trait):units,    # residual covariance among traits
    family = rep("gaussian", length(responses)),
    pedigree = nu_tree,
    data = df,
    prior = prior_multi,
    nitt = 80000, burnin = 20000, thin = 100,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  return(model)
}

# -------------------------------
# Run intercept-only MR-PMM
# -------------------------------
intercept_model <- fit_intercept_only_model(
  responses = responses,
  data = data,
  nu_tree = nu_tree
)

par(mfrow=c(3,2), mar=c(2,2,1,0))
plot(intercept_model$Sol, auto.layout=F)


# -------------------------------
# Save full model for later reload
# -------------------------------
saveRDS(intercept_model, "Intercept_only_MRPMM_scaled_last.rds")


# -------------------------------
# Extract correlations
# -------------------------------

# Posterior means of (co)variance matrices
phylo_cov <- matrix(
  colMeans(intercept_model$VCV[, grep("animal", colnames(intercept_model$VCV))]),
  nrow = length(responses), byrow = TRUE
)
resid_cov <- matrix(
  colMeans(intercept_model$VCV[, grep("units", colnames(intercept_model$VCV))]),
  nrow = length(responses), byrow = TRUE
)

# Convert to correlations
phylo_cor <- cov2cor(phylo_cov)
resid_cor <- cov2cor(resid_cov)

# Add row/column names for clarity
rownames(phylo_cor) <- colnames(phylo_cor) <- responses
rownames(resid_cor) <- colnames(resid_cor) <- responses

# Save as CSVs
write.csv(phylo_cor, "Phylogenetic_correlations_scaled_last.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(resid_cor, "Residual_correlations_scaled_last.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Print quick check
cat("\nPhylogenetic correlations:\n")
print(round(phylo_cor, 3))
cat("\nResidual correlations:\n")
print(round(resid_cor, 3))



# ============================================================
# Compute phylogenetic signal per trait from intercept-only MR-PMM
# ============================================================

compute_phylo_signal <- function(model, responses) {
  n_traits <- length(responses)
  
  # Extract variance components from posterior samples
  VCV <- model$VCV
  phylo_idx <- grep("animal", colnames(VCV))
  resid_idx <- grep("units", colnames(VCV))
  
  phylo_signal_results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:n_traits) {
    # extract variance for this trait across MCMC samples
    phylo_var <- VCV[, phylo_idx[(i - 1) * n_traits + i]]
    resid_var <- VCV[, resid_idx[(i - 1) * n_traits + i]]
    
    h2 <- phylo_var / (phylo_var + resid_var)
    
    phylo_signal_results[[responses[i]]] <- data.frame(
      Trait = responses[i],
      Mean = mean(h2),
      LowerCI = quantile(h2, 0.025),
      UpperCI = quantile(h2, 0.975)
    )
  }
  
  phylo_signal_df <- do.call(rbind, phylo_signal_results)
  return(phylo_signal_df)
}

# -------------------------------
# Run signal computation
# -------------------------------
phylo_signal_df <- compute_phylo_signal(intercept_model, responses)

print(phylo_signal_df)
write.csv(phylo_signal_df, "Phylogenetic_signal_per_trait_scaled_last.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

>snippet 3: for greater interpretability, we run single-response phylogenetic mixed models (SR-PMM) to estimate the predictor combinations that best explain each suture morphology variable. Predictors include biological traits (habitat, locomotion, diet, lifespan, gestation length, weaning age) and the classification of sutures within the dataset (suture identity). To maintain a reasonable runtime, a maximum of three predictors per model are tested, for all combinations of predictors.

```{r, 3) SR(single-response)-PMM models}

# -------------------------------

responses <- responses[responses %in% colnames(data)]

# Keep only complete rows for predictors

# -------------------------------

  # get the tip

    # get the age
    this_age <- ages$age[ages$elements == this_tip]

pruned_tree -> nu_tree

# Alignment sanity check
if (!all(unique(data$species) %in% rownames(invA))) {

}

# -------------------------------

library(MCMCglmm)
library(combinat)  # for predictor combinations

get_predictor_combinations <- function(predictors, max_terms = 3) {
  combos <- list()
  for (i in 1:max_terms) {
    combos <- c(combos, combn(predictors, i, simplify = FALSE))
  }
  return(combos)
}



# -------------------------------
# Single-response (univariate) model selection
# -------------------------------

fit_single_response_models_fixed <- function(responses, data, predictors, nu_tree, max_predictors = 3) {
  df <- data
  df$animal <- df$species
  
  # Prior for univariate model: residual + phylo variance
  prior_uni <- list(
    R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
    G = list(G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002))
  )
  
  # Get all predictor combinations
  predictor_sets <- get_predictor_combinations(predictors, max_terms = max_predictors)
  
  all_results <- list()
  
  for (trait in responses) {
    cat("Running models for trait:", trait, "\n")
    
    df_trait <- df[complete.cases(df[, c(trait, predictors)]), ]
    
    trait_results <- list()
    
    for (pred_set in predictor_sets) {
      pred_str <- paste(pred_set, collapse = " + ")
      fixed_formula <- as.formula(paste(trait, "~", pred_str))
      
      tryCatch({
        model <- MCMCglmm(
          fixed = fixed_formula,
          random = ~ animal,          # phylogenetic effect
          rcov   = ~ units,           # residual
          family = "gaussian",
          pedigree = nu_tree,
          data = df_trait,
          prior = prior_uni,
          nitt = 80000, burnin = 20000, thin = 100,
          verbose = FALSE
        )
        
        trait_results[[pred_str]] <- list(
          model = model,
          DIC = model$DIC,
          predictors = pred_set,
          fixed_effects = summary(model)$solutions
        )
        
        cat("Finished model | Trait:", trait, "| Predictors:", pred_str, "| DIC:", model$DIC, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error fitting model for trait:", trait, "| Predictors:", pred_str, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    if (length(trait_results) > 0) {
      best_model <- trait_results[[which.min(sapply(trait_results, function(x) x$DIC))]]
      all_results[[trait]] <- list(
        all_models = trait_results,
        best_model = best_model,
        best_DIC = best_model$DIC,
        best_predictors = best_model$predictors
      )
    }
  }
  
  return(all_results)
}

# -------------------------------
# Run single-response selection
# -------------------------------
single_results_fixed <- fit_single_response_models_fixed(
  responses = responses,
  data = data,
  predictors = predictors,
  nu_tree = nu_tree,
  max_predictors = 3
)
saveRDS(single_results_fixed, "SR_suturefixed_last.RDS")

# -------------------------------
# Summarize best models for each trait
# -------------------------------
best_models_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(single_results_fixed), function(trait) {
  res <- single_results_fixed[[trait]]
  data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    DIC = res$best_DIC,
    Predictors = paste(res$best_predictors, collapse = ", "),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

print(best_models_summary)
write.csv(best_models_summary, "Best_single_response_models_scaled_suturefixed_last.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# -------------------------------
# Summarize all models for each trait
# -------------------------------

all_models_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(single_results_fixed), function(trait) {
  res <- single_results_fixed[[trait]]
  
  if (is.null(res$all_models)) return(NULL)  # skip if no models
  
  do.call(rbind, lapply(res$all_models, function(mod) {
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      DIC = mod$DIC,
      Predictors = paste(mod$predictors, collapse = ", "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}))

# Sort by trait, then DIC
all_models_summary <- all_models_summary[order(all_models_summary$Trait, all_models_summary$DIC), ]

print(all_models_summary)
write.csv(all_models_summary, "All_single_response_models_scaled_suturefixed_last.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

>snippet 4: given that suture identity (var. name 'suture') is retrieved as being consistently and by far the strongest predictor of each suture morphology response variable (indicating that sutures are significantly different from each other), suture identity is recast as a random effect in addition to phylogenetic structure. This is to unbias further analyses from the effect of differences among sutures across skulls.

```{r, 4) SR-PMM models with suture as random effect}

get_predictor_combinations <- function(predictors, max_terms = 3) {

# -------------------------------
# Single-response (univariate) model selection
# -------------------------------
fit_single_response_models <- function(responses, data, predictors, nu_tree, max_predictors = 3) {
  df <- data
  df$animal <- df$species  # phylogenetic grouping factor
  
  # Prior for univariate model: residual + phylo variance + suture variance
  prior_uni <- list(
    R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
    G = list(
      G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),  # phylogeny
      G2 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002)   # suture
    )
  )

  # Get all predictor combinations
  predictor_sets <- get_predictor_combinations(predictors, max_terms = max_predictors)
  
  all_results <- list()
  
  for (trait in responses) {
    cat("Running models for trait:", trait, "\n")
    
    df_trait <- df[complete.cases(df[, c(trait, predictors, "suture")]), ]
    
    trait_results <- list()
    
    for (pred_set in predictor_sets) {
      pred_str <- paste(pred_set, collapse = " + ")
      fixed_formula <- as.formula(paste(trait, "~", pred_str))  
      
      tryCatch({
        model <- MCMCglmm(
          fixed    = fixed_formula,
          random   = ~ animal + suture,   # ✅ phylogeny + suture
          rcov     = ~ units,
          family   = "gaussian",
          pedigree = nu_tree,
          data     = df_trait,
          prior    = prior_uni,
          nitt     = 80000, burnin = 20000, thin = 100,
          verbose  = FALSE
        )
        
        trait_results[[pred_str]] <- list(
          model = model,
          DIC = model$DIC,
          predictors = pred_set,
          fixed_effects = summary(model)$solutions
        )
        
        cat("Finished model | Trait:", trait, "| Predictors:", pred_str, "| DIC:", model$DIC, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error fitting model for trait:", trait, "| Predictors:", pred_str, "\n")
      })
    }
    
    if (length(trait_results) > 0) {
      best_model <- trait_results[[which.min(sapply(trait_results, function(x) x$DIC))]]
      all_results[[trait]] <- list(
        all_models = trait_results,
        best_model = best_model,
        best_DIC = best_model$DIC,
        best_predictors = best_model$predictors
      )
    }
  }
  
  return(all_results)
}

# -------------------------------
# Run single-response selection
# -------------------------------
single_results_random_fixed_last <- fit_single_response_models(
  responses = responses,
  data = data,
  predictors = predictors,
  nu_tree = nu_tree,
  max_predictors = 3
)

saveRDS(single_results_random_fixed_last, "SR_random_fixed_individual_last.RDS")

# -------------------------------
# Helper to create safe filenames
# -------------------------------
safe_filename <- function(x) {
  # Replace any non-alphanumeric characters with underscore
  gsub("[^[:alnum:]_]", "_", x)
}

# -------------------------------
# Save all models safely
# -------------------------------
for (trait in names(single_results_random_fixed_last)) {
  res <- single_results_random_fixed_last[[trait]]
  
  if (!is.null(res$all_models)) {
    for (mod_name in names(res$all_models)) {
      model_obj <- res$all_models[[mod_name]]$model
      safe_name <- safe_filename(mod_name)
      filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("random_", trait, "_", safe_name, ".rds"))
      
      tryCatch({
        saveRDS(model_obj, file = filename)
        cat("Saved model for trait", trait, "with predictors", mod_name, "->", filename, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Failed to save model for trait", trait, "with predictors", mod_name, "\n",
            "Error:", e$message, "\n")
      })
    }
  }
  
  # Save best model
  best_model <- res$best_model$model
  filename_best <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("best_random_scaled_fixed_last", trait, "_best_model.rds"))
  
  tryCatch({
    saveRDS(best_model, file = filename_best)
    cat("Saved BEST model for trait", trait, "->", filename_best, "\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Failed to save BEST model for trait", trait, "\n", "Error:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}
```

>snippet 5: SR-PMM models with interaction between fixed effects. This is to test the interactions between predictors for the most supported models from (4)

```{r, 5) specific SR-PMM interaction models to test hypotheses}
# ============================================================
# RUN ONLY USER-DEFINED INTERACTION MODELS (MCMCglmm)
# ============================================================

library(MCMCglmm)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. PRIOR (same as pipeline univariate prior)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
prior_uni <- list(
  R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
  G = list(
    G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),  # phylogeny (animal)
    G2 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002)   # suture
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. FUNCTION TO RUN ONLY SELECTED MODELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_specific_models <- function(model_list, data, nu_tree) {
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (name in names(model_list)) {
    f <- model_list[[name]]
    cat("\n=============================================\n")
    cat("Running:", name, "\nFormula:", deparse(f), "\n")
    cat("=============================================\n")
    
    # extract variables from formula
    vars <- all.vars(f)
    
    # remove missing rows
    df_sub <- data[complete.cases(data[, vars]), ]
    
    # fit model
    model <- MCMCglmm(
      fixed = f,
      random = ~ animal + suture,
      rcov = ~ units,
      family = "gaussian",
      pedigree = nu_tree,
      data = df_sub,
      prior = prior_uni,
      nitt = 80000, burnin = 20000, thin = 100,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # store result
    results[[name]] <- list(
      formula = f,
      model = model,
      DIC = model$DIC,
      fixed_effects = summary(model)$solutions,
      random_effects = summary(model)$Gcovariances,
      diagnostics = list(
        autocorr = autocorr.diag(model$Sol),
        heidel = heidel.diag(model$Sol),
        geweke = geweke.diag(model$Sol)
      )
    )
    
    cat("Finished:", name, "| DIC =", model$DIC, "\n")
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

>snippet 7: a helper to select top models per response trait based on their DIC difference from best model

```{r, 7) helper for top model selection}
# Load model summary spreadsheet
df <- read.csv("D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/fixed_sutures.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) #use the csv output from the previous snippet to parse the top models

# Ensure DIC is numeric
df$DIC <- as.numeric(df$DIC)

# Compute ΔDIC per Trait
df_filtered <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(df, df$Trait), function(subdf) {
  
  # Find minimum DIC for this trait
  min_dic <- min(subdf$DIC, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Compute ΔDIC
  subdf$Delta_DIC <- subdf$DIC - min_dic
  
  # Keep rows with ΔDIC ≤ 5
  subdf[subdf$Delta_DIC <= 5, ]
}))

# Save new filtered table
write.csv(df_filtered, "fixed_sutures_filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# additional filtering to keep only significant models
df <- read.csv("fixed_sutures_filtered.csv", header = TRUE)

# Select significant effects based on pMCMC and non-overlap with zero
sig_models <- subset(df, pMCMC < 0.05,
         l.95..CI > 0 | u.95..CI < 0)

# View results
sig_models

write.csv(sig_models, "fixed_sutures_filtered_signif.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

>snippet 8: a helper to recenter and plot significant pairwise contrasts to include the base intercept level

```{r, 8) helper for posterior pairwise contrast rebalancing and plotting}
library(MCMCglmm)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load model
# ------------------------------------------------------------
model_path <- "D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/SR_random_fixed_individual_last.RDS" #use the RDS file containing your models
model <- readRDS(model_path)

alpha_names <- names(model)

pairwise_results <- list()

out_dir <- "pairwise_plots_habitat_last"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir)
}

for (alpha in alpha_names) {

  message("Processing: ", alpha)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Safety check
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (!"all_models" %in% names(model[[alpha]])) next

  model_list <- model[[alpha]]$all_models

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Collect DIC values
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  model_dics <- sapply(model_list, function(m) {
    if (!is.null(m$model$DIC)) m$model$DIC else NA
  })

  model_dics <- model_dics[!is.na(model_dics)]
  if (length(model_dics) == 0) next

  best_dic <- min(model_dics)
  delta_dic <- model_dics - best_dic

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Check if habitat model exists
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (!"habitat" %in% names(model_list)) next

  primary_delta_dic <- delta_dic["habitat"]

  message("Best DIC: ", best_dic)
  message("habitat ΔDIC: ", primary_delta_dic)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Filter BEFORE posterior extraction
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (is.na(primary_delta_dic) || primary_delta_dic > 5) {
    message("Skipping ", alpha, " (ΔDIC > 5)")
    next
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract posterior draws
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  post <- as.data.frame(
    model_list$habitat$model$Sol
  )

  # Identify habitat columns
  habitat_cols <- grep("^habitat", colnames(post), value = TRUE)
  if (length(habitat_cols) == 0) next

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Reconstruct posterior means for each level
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  baseline <- post$`(Intercept)`

  habitat_posteriors <- lapply(habitat_cols, function(col)
    baseline + post[[col]]
  )

  names(habitat_posteriors) <- gsub("^habitat", "", habitat_cols)

  # Add reference level
  habitat_posteriors[["reference"]] <- baseline

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Pairwise combinations
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  habitat_names <- names(habitat_posteriors)

  pairs <- expand.grid(habitat_names, habitat_names, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  pairs <- pairs[pairs$Var1 != pairs$Var2, ]

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Posterior summaries
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  pairwise_diffs <- apply(pairs, 1, function(x) {

    diff_post <- habitat_posteriors[[x[1]]] - habitat_posteriors[[x[2]]]

    data.frame(
      alpha      = alpha,
      Comparison = paste(x[1], "−", x[2]),
      post_mean  = mean(diff_post),
      CI_lower   = quantile(diff_post, 0.025),
      CI_upper   = quantile(diff_post, 0.975),
      pMCMC      = 2 * min(mean(diff_post > 0), mean(diff_post < 0))
    )

  }) |> bind_rows()

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Full posterior draws
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  pairwise_post <- apply(pairs, 1, function(x) {

    diff_post <- habitat_posteriors[[x[1]]] - habitat_posteriors[[x[2]]]

    data.frame(
      alpha      = alpha,
      Comparison = paste(x[1], "−", x[2]),
      diff       = diff_post
    )

  }) |> bind_rows()

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Filter significant contrasts
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  sig_names <- pairwise_diffs %>%
    filter(pMCMC <= 0.05) %>%
    pull(Comparison)

  pairwise_post_sig <- pairwise_post %>%
    filter(Comparison %in% sig_names)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Store results
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  pairwise_results[[alpha]] <- list(
    summary  = pairwise_diffs,
    post_sig = pairwise_post_sig,
    deltaDIC = primary_delta_dic,
    bestDIC  = best_dic
  )
}

 
pairwise_alpha_habitat <- pairwise_results$alpha_complexity_res$summary%>%
    filter(pMCMC <= 0.05 | CI_lower > 0 | CI_upper < 0)

pairwise_FD_habitat <- pairwise_results$FD_res$summary%>%
    filter(pMCMC <= 0.05 | CI_lower > 0 | CI_upper < 0)

pairwise_Concavity_habitat <- pairwise_results$Concavity_res$summary%>%
    filter(pMCMC <= 0.05 | CI_lower > 0 | CI_upper < 0)

pairwise_Antisphericity_habitat <- pairwise_results$Antisphericity_res$summary%>%
    filter(pMCMC <= 0.05 | CI_lower > 0 | CI_upper < 0)

pairwise_Rugosity_habitat <- pairwise_results$Rugosity_res$summary%>%
    filter(pMCMC <= 0.05 | CI_lower > 0 | CI_upper < 0)


combined_results <- bind_rows(
  pairwise_alpha_habitat,
  pairwise_FD_habitat,
  pairwise_Concavity_habitat,
  pairwise_Antisphericity_habitat,
  pairwise_Rugosity_habitat
)

write.csv(combined_results, "pairwise_habitat_results.csv", row.names = FALSE) # repeat by substituting 'habitat' with 'locomotion' or 'primary_diet' across the whole snippet

```

```{r, 9) helper function to generate sankey plot of significant effects}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsankeyfier)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)

# --- Load data --- use the significance csv summary from the selection helper output
sig_summary <- read.csv(
  "D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/single_results_random_fixed_last_new_filtered_signif_summary.csv", 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- Predictor grouping ---
sig_summary <- sig_summary %>%
  mutate(
    PredictorCombined = case_when(
      grepl("^locomotion", Predictor, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "locomotion",
      grepl("^habitat", Predictor, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "habitat",
      grepl("^primary_diet", Predictor, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "diet",
     # Predictor == "weaning_age" ~ "weaning age",
     # Predictor == "ln_body_mass_g" ~ "body size",
      #Predictor == "ln_brain_mass_g" ~ "brain size",
     #Predictor == "gestation_length" ~ "gestation length",
      #Predictor == "typical lifespan" ~ "lifespan",
      grepl("^ln_", Predictor, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "biological scaling",
      grepl("typical_lifespan|weaning_age|gestation_length", Predictor, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "life history duration",
      TRUE ~ Predictor
    ),
    PredictorCombined = tolower(trimws(PredictorCombined))
  )

# --- Response grouping ---
sig_summary <- sig_summary %>%
  mutate(
    ResponseCombined = case_when(
      Trait == "Antisphericity_res" ~ "antisphericity",
      Trait == "Concavity_res" ~ "concavity",
      Trait == "alpha_complexity_res" ~ "alpha complexity",
      Trait == "FD_res" ~ "fractal dimensions",
      Trait == "Rugosity_res" ~ "rugosity",
      TRUE ~ Trait
    ),
    ResponseCombined = tolower(trimws(ResponseCombined))
  )

# --- Aggregate data ---
agg_df <- sig_summary %>%
  group_by(ResponseCombined, PredictorCombined) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(post.mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    abs_effect  = mean(abs(post.mean), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_models    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    intensity = rescale(abs_effect, to = c(0.3,0.9)),
    link_color = case_when(
      PredictorCombined %in% c("locomotion","habitat","diet") ~ alpha("#00CCCC", intensity),
      mean_effect >= 0 ~ alpha("#6699FF", intensity),
      mean_effect < 0  ~ alpha("#FF00FF", intensity),
      TRUE ~ alpha("grey60", intensity)
    )
  )

# --- Pivot to long format ---
sankey_data <- pivot_stages_longer(
  data = agg_df,
  stages_from = c("ResponseCombined", "PredictorCombined"),
  values_from = "n_models",
  additional_aes_from = "link_color"
)

# --- Define vertical order ---
response_order <- c(
  "antisphericity",
  "concavity",
  "alpha complexity",
  "fractal dimensions",
  "rugosity"
)
 
predictor_order <- c(
  "habitat",
  "diet",
  "locomotion",
  #"gestation length",
  #"weaning age",
  #"lifespan"
  "life history duration",
  "biological scaling"
)

# --- Convert node to factor and sort for as_is ordering ---
sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    node = case_when(
      stage == "ResponseCombined" ~ factor(node, levels = response_order),
      stage == "PredictorCombined" ~ factor(node, levels = predictor_order),
      TRUE ~ node
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(stage, node)

# --- Position object with as_is ordering ---
pos <- position_sankey(v_space = 10, align = "justify", order = "as_is")

# --- Plot ---
p<-ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
      x = stage,
      y = n_models,
      group = node,
      connector = connector,
      edge_id = edge_id,
      node_id = node
    )) +
  geom_sankeyedge(aes(fill = link_color), position = pos, alpha = 1) +
  geom_sankeynode(position = pos, fill = "grey85", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = node, hjust = after_stat(ifelse(connector=="from",-0.1,1.1))),
    stat = "sankeynode",
    position = pos,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Response","Predictor group"), expand = c(0.1,0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Specific Response → Predictor Group (ordered nodes)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of models"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# --- Save as editable PDF ---
ggsave(
  "global_summary_Sankey_static_ggsankeyfier_last_new.pdf",
  plot = p,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 14,
  height = 9
)

cat("✅ Static Sankey with vertical spacing and exact order saved as editable PDF\n")

```

>snippet 10: a helper to generate a PCA of suture mean values and extract PCA loadings

```{r, 10) generate PCA plot}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ================================
# 1. Variable selection
# ================================
all_resp_vars <- c(
   "Concavity_res", 
  "Antisphericity_res", "FD_res", "Rugosity_res","alpha_complexity_res")

all_resp_vars <- all_resp_vars[all_resp_vars %in% colnames(data)]

size_vars <- c("HeightRange", "Planar", "centroid_size_mm", "actual_volume")

resp_vars_nosize <- setdiff(all_resp_vars, size_vars)

# Dataset 
df_res <- data %>%
  select(all_of(resp_vars_nosize), suture)



# ================================
# 4. PCA on residuals
# ================================
pca_res <- prcomp(df_res %>% select(all_of(resp_vars_nosize)),
                  center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

#pca_res$x[, "PC1"]    <- -pca_res$x[, "PC1"]
#pca_res$rotation[, "PC1"] <- -pca_res$rotation[, "PC1"]

pca_res$x[, "PC2"]    <- -pca_res$x[, "PC2"]
pca_res$rotation[, "PC2"] <- -pca_res$rotation[, "PC2"]


eigen_res <- pca_res$sdev^2
prop_res  <- eigen_res / sum(eigen_res)




suture_regions <- data.frame(
  suture = c(
    "coronal", "frontojugal", "frontomaxillary", "frontonasal",
    "frontopremaxillary", "interfrontal", "internasal", "interpalatine",
    "lambdoid", "maxillaryjugal", "maxillarypalatine", "maxillarypremaxillary",
    "nasomaxillary", "nasopremaxillary", "occipital", "occipitoparietal",
    "sagittal", "sphenofrontal", "squamosalparietal", "squamosooccipital",
    "temporozygomatic"
  ),
  Region = c(
    "Neurocranial", "Transitional", "Transitional", "Transitional",
    "Transitional", "Neurocranial", "Viscerocranial", "Viscerocranial",
    "Neurocranial", "Viscerocranial", "Viscerocranial", "Viscerocranial",
    "Viscerocranial", "Viscerocranial", "Neurocranial", "Neurocranial",
    "Neurocranial", "Neurocranial", "Neurocranial", "Neurocranial",
    "Transitional"
  )
)
# ================================
# 5. Scores and suture means
# ================================
scores_res <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x) %>%
  mutate(suture = df_res$suture)

means_res <- scores_res %>%
  group_by(suture) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("PC"), mean))



# Add Region information
means_res <- means_res %>%
  left_join(suture_regions, by = c("suture" = "suture"))


# ================================
# 6. Region convex hulls
# ================================
region_hulls_res <- means_res %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  slice(chull(PC1, PC2)) %>%
  ungroup()


# ================================
# 7. Loadings (arrows)
# ================================
load_res <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation[,1:3])
load_res$var <- rownames(load_res)


mult_res <- 0.6 * min(
  diff(range(means_res$PC1)) / diff(range(load_res$PC1)),
  diff(range(means_res$PC2)) / diff(range(load_res$PC2))
)

load_res <- load_res %>%
  mutate(arrow_x = PC1 * mult_res,
         arrow_y = PC2 * mult_res)


# ================================
# 8. Plot PCA
# ================================


p_res <- 
  pdf("PCA_sutures_last_new.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
  ggplot(means_res, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_polygon(data = region_hulls_res,
               aes(fill = Region, group = Region),
               alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Region), size = 4, shape = 21, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = suture, color = Region),
                  size = 4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = load_res,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = arrow_x, yend = arrow_y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.02, "npc"))) +
  geom_text_repel(data = load_res,
                  aes(x = arrow_x, y = arrow_y, label = var),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA on Residuals (Regressed on Scaled Centroid Size)",
    subtitle = "best_alpha, Convexity, Sphericity inverted; region-level convex hulls",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(prop_res[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(prop_res[2] * 100, 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

dev.off()

pca_res$rotation[,1:3]
prop_res[1] * 100
prop_res[2] * 100
prop_res[3] * 100

sapply(df_res[resp_vars_nosize], var)

```

>snippet 12: convergence testing on the final model design (single-responses, with sutures as a random effect). Run only after models (or a sample of models) have been already run, so that the data is already loaded in your environment. To save processing time, the process currently runs based on the best models with significant effects.

```{r, 12) convergence testing and diagnostics for individual model suitability (the most supported)}

#analysis done only on single-response models, with suture as a random effect, that display significant effects, and are within 5 DIC values from the best model for a given response variable

# ============================================================
# RUN SELECTED MODELS FROM CSV WITH 2 CHAINS + GELMAN-RUBIN
# ============================================================

library(MCMCglmm)
library(coda)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. PRIOR
# ------------------------------------------------------------
prior_uni <- list(
  R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
  G = list(
    G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
    G2 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002)
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. READ CSV + REMOVE DUPLICATES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
df_models <- read.csv("D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/single_results_random_fixed_last_new_filtered_signif_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) #use csv with significant effects summaries for the best models
df_models <- unique(df_models[, c("Trait", "Predictors_set")])

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. BUILD FORMULA FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_formula <- function(trait, predictors_string) {
  preds <- unlist(strsplit(predictors_string, ","))
  preds <- trimws(preds)
  as.formula(paste(trait, "~", paste(preds, collapse = " + ")))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. RUN MODELS (2 CHAINS EACH)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_models))) {
  
  trait <- df_models$Trait[i]
  preds <- df_models$Predictors_set[i]
  
  f <- build_formula(trait, preds)
  name <- paste(trait, preds, sep = "_")
  
  cat("\n=============================================\n")
  cat("Running:", name, "\nFormula:", deparse(f), "\n")
  cat("=============================================\n")
  
  # subset data
  vars <- all.vars(f)
  df_sub <- data[complete.cases(data[, vars]), ]
  
  # ---------------------------
  # RUN TWO CHAINS
  # ---------------------------
  
  model1 <- MCMCglmm(
    fixed = f,
    random = ~ animal + suture,
    rcov = ~ units,
    family = "gaussian",
    pedigree = nu_tree,
    data = df_sub,
    prior = prior_uni,
    nitt = 80000, burnin = 20000, thin = 100,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  model2 <- MCMCglmm(
    fixed = f,
    random = ~ animal + suture,
    rcov = ~ units,
    family = "gaussian",
    pedigree = nu_tree,
    data = df_sub,
    prior = prior_uni,
    nitt = 80000, burnin = 20000, thin = 100,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # ---------------------------
  # COMBINE CHAINS
  # ---------------------------
  
  chains <- mcmc.list(model1$Sol, model2$Sol)
  
  # ---------------------------
  # GELMAN-RUBIN
  # ---------------------------
  
  gr <- gelman.diag(chains, multivariate = FALSE)
  converged <- all(gr$psrf[,1] < 1.1)
  
  # ---------------------------
  # STORE RESULTS
  # ---------------------------
  
  results[[name]] <- list(
    formula = f,
    model_chain1 = model1,
    model_chain2 = model2,
    DIC = mean(c(model1$DIC, model2$DIC)),
    gelman_rubin = gr,
    converged = converged
  )
  
  cat("Finished:", name,
      "| mean DIC =", round(results[[name]]$DIC, 2),
      "| converged =", converged, "\n")
  
  # optional save per model
  # saveRDS(results[[name]], file = paste0("models/", name, ".rds"))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. LIST NON-CONVERGED MODELS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bad_models <- names(results)[!sapply(results, function(x) x$converged)]

cat("\n=============================\n")
cat("Non-converged models:\n")
print(bad_models)
cat("=============================\n")


summary_list <- list()

for (name in names(results)) {
  
  gr <- results[[name]]$gelman_rubin$psrf
  
  df <- data.frame(
    model = name,
    parameter = rownames(gr),
    Rhat = gr[,1],
    upper_CI = gr[,2],
    converged = gr[,1] < 1.1
  )
  
  summary_list[[name]] <- df
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list)

write.csv(summary_df, "D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/gelman_rubin_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

model_summary <- data.frame(
  model = names(results),
  max_Rhat = sapply(results, function(x) max(x$gelman_rubin$psrf[,1])),
  mean_Rhat = sapply(results, function(x) mean(x$gelman_rubin$psrf[,1])),
  converged = sapply(results, function(x) all(x$gelman_rubin$psrf[,1] < 1.1)),
  DIC = sapply(results, function(x) x$DIC)
)

write.csv(model_summary, "D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/model_level_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

out_dir <- "D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/gelman_plots/"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

for (name in names(results)) {
  
  # clean filename (important if names contain special characters)
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", name)
  
  file_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("gelman_", safe_name, ".pdf"))
  
  pdf(file_path, width = 6, height = 6)
  
  chains <- mcmc.list(
    results[[name]]$model_chain1$Sol,
    results[[name]]$model_chain2$Sol
  )
  
  gelman.plot(chains)
  title(main = name)
  
  dev.off()
}

library(coda)

diag_summary <- data.frame(
  model = names(results),
  multivariate_psrf = vapply(results, function(x) {
    
    chains <- mcmc.list(
      x$model_chain1$Sol,
      x$model_chain2$Sol
    )
    
    gr <- gelman.diag(chains, multivariate = TRUE)
    
    val <- gr$mpsrf
    if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) NA else val
    
  }, numeric(1))
)

write.csv(diag_summary, "D:/Marco_backups/pipeline/gelman_multivariate.csv", row.names = FALSE)

out_dir <- "D:/Marco_backups/trace_plots/"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

library(coda)

for (name in names(results)) {
  
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", name)
  file_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("trace_", safe_name, ".pdf"))
  
  pdf(file_path, width = 14, height = 8)
  
  # combine both chains
  chains <- mcmc.list(
    results[[name]]$model_chain1$Sol,
    results[[name]]$model_chain2$Sol
  )
  
  par(mfrow = c(2,2), mar = c(2, 1, 2, 1))
  plot(chains, ask = FALSE, auto.layout = FALSE)
  title(main = name)
  
  dev.off()
}
```
